mapper.insert: INSERT INTO molds ( id, mold_code, name, category, product_project, location, manufacturer, supplier, purchase_date, current_status, total_usage_count, total_production_time, last_maintenance_date, purchase_cost, total_repair_cost, total_maintenance_cost, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{moldCode}, #{name}, #{category}, #{productProject}, #{location}, #{manufacturer}, #{supplier}, #{purchaseDate}, #{currentStatus}, #{totalUsageCount}, #{totalProductionTime}, #{lastMaintenanceDate}, #{purchaseCost}, #{totalRepairCost}, #{totalMaintenanceCost}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update molds set current_status = #{status} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.mold_code, m.name, m.category, m.product_project, m.location, m.manufacturer, m.purchase_date, m.current_status, m.total_usage_count, m.total_production_time, m.last_maintenance_date, m.purchase_cost, s.dimensions, s.material, s.cavity_count, s.design_life_cycles, s.design_life_years, s.key_dimensions FROM molds m LEFT JOIN mold_specs s ON s.mold_id = m.id ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.id
SELECT id, qrcode_type, is_active, created_at FROM mold_qrcodes WHERE mold_id = #{id} ORDER BY qrcode_type LIMIT 1
SELECT id, file_type, original_name, file_path, file_name, file_size, upload_time, description FROM files WHERE biz_type = 'mold' AND biz_id = #{id} ORDER BY upload_time DESC
mapper.sql: m.id, m.mold_code, m.name, m.category, m.product_project, m.location, m.manufacturer, m.purchase_date, m.current_status, m.total_usage_count, m.total_production_time, m.last_maintenance_date, m.purchase_cost, s.dimensions, s.material, s.cavity_count, s.design_life_cycles, s.design_life_years, s.key_dimensions
